concepts.name: Great Plains
concepts.definition: Broad expanse of prairie and grassland flatland east of the Rocky Mountains, stretching ~3,200 km across the central United States and southern Canada.

concepts.name: Pampas
concepts.definition: Fertile temperate lowland grasslands covering over 1.2 million km² of southeastern South America across Argentina, Uruguay and southern Brazil.

concepts.name: Eurasian Steppe
concepts.definition: The vast temperate grassland belt stretching about 8,000 km across Eurasia, from Manchuria and Mongolia through Kazakhstan and Russia to Ukraine and Hungary.

concepts.name: Pontic-Caspian Steppe
concepts.definition: Western arm of the Eurasian Steppe, running from the northern Black Sea shore across southern Ukraine and southern Russia to the Caspian Sea.

concepts.name: Kazakh Steppe
concepts.definition: The world's largest dry steppe, a vast open grassland covering northern Kazakhstan and adjacent Russia, spanning more than 2,200 km.

concepts.name: North China Plain
concepts.definition: China's largest alluvial plain, built by Yellow River deposits and ringed by mountains, covering Henan, Hebei and Shandong provinces around the Bohai and Yellow Seas.

concepts.name: Indo-Gangetic Plain
concepts.definition: Fertile ~700,000-km² lowland across the northern Indian subcontinent, drained by the Indus and Ganges systems through Pakistan, India, Nepal and Bangladesh.

concepts.name: Llanos
concepts.definition: Vast tropical grassland plain east of the Andes in the Orinoco River basin, spanning eastern Colombia and western Venezuela.

concepts.name: Campos
concepts.definition: Temperate grasslands of southern Brazil (Campos Sulinos), the subtropical northern extension of the South American Pampas in Rio Grande do Sul.

concepts.name: Veld
concepts.definition: Open grassland or low-scrub landscape of the interior plateau of Southern Africa, spanning South Africa and neighbouring Namibia, Zimbabwe, Botswana and Lesotho.
